CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_admin()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select exists (
    select 1 from public.app_users
    where id = auth.uid()
      and role = 'admin'
      and account_state = 'active'
  );
$function$
functions.name: is_admin

functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.prohibit_financial_record_delete()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
begin
  raise exception using errcode = '22023', message = 'Financial records cannot be deleted.';
end;
$function$
functions.name: prohibit_financial_record_delete
